mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about Jayaprakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary (Surha Tal) is incorrect?
options: It is located in Ballia district of Uttar Pradesh.
It became India’s 100th Ramsar Site in June 2026.
It is a saline wetland located in Aligarh district.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that Surha Tal is a saline wetland located in Aligarh district. It is a freshwater wetland in Ballia district of Uttar Pradesh; Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary is located in Aligarh and was India’s 99th Ramsar Site.

mcqs.question: Which Ramsar Sites were added on World Environment Day, 5 June 2025?
options: Patna Bird Sanctuary and Chhari-Dhand Wetland
mcqs.explanation: Menar Wetland and Khichan Wetland were added on 5 June 2025, observed as World Environment Day. Gokul Reservoir and Udaipur Jheel were added in September 2025, while Siliserh Lake and Kopra Reservoir were added in December 2025.

mcqs.question:
Match the Ramsar Sites with their States:

List-I
(a) Sakkarakottai Bird Sanctuary
(b) Therthangal Bird Sanctuary
(c) Khecheopalri Wetland
(d) Udhwa Lake

List-II
(i) Jharkhand
(ii) Sikkim
(iii) Tamil Nadu
(iv) Tamil Nadu
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-iv, c-ii and d-i: Sakkarakottai Bird Sanctuary and Therthangal Bird Sanctuary are in Tamil Nadu, Khecheopalri Wetland is in Sikkim, and Udhwa Lake is in Jharkhand. The other codes incorrectly interchange these State associations.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Gokul Reservoir was added as a Ramsar Site in September 2025 and is located in Buxar, Bihar.
Statement B: Udaipur Jheel was added as a Ramsar Site in September 2025 and is located in West Champaran, Bihar.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Gokul Reservoir is in Buxar, Bihar, and Udaipur Jheel is in West Champaran, Bihar; both were added in September 2025.

mcqs.question:
With reference to India and the Ramsar Convention, consider the following statements:
Statement A: India joined the Ramsar Convention on 1 February 1982.
Statement B: India joined the Ramsar Convention on 1 February 1981.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is correct: India joined the Ramsar Convention on 1 February 1982. Statement B is incorrect because it changes the accession year to 1981.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the Ramsar Convention:
Assertion (A): The Ramsar Convention was signed in 1971 at Chilika Lake, Odisha.
Reason (R): The Convention concerns wetlands of international importance.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: The Assertion is false because the Convention was signed in 1971 at Ramsar, Iran, not at Chilika Lake, Odisha. The Reason is true because the Convention concerns wetlands of international importance.

mcqs.keyword: Year and State of Ramsar site
mcqs.question: Chhari-Dhand Wetland, designated as a Ramsar site in 2026, is located in which State?
mcqs.explanation: Chhari-Dhand Wetland is a Ramsar site in Gujarat, designated in 2026. Madhya Pradesh, Bihar and Karnataka have other Ramsar sites listed in the same state-wise compilation, but not Chhari-Dhand Wetland.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding Ramsar sites and their States.

List-I
 a. Kolleru Lake
 b. Nagi Bird Sanctuary
 c. Nanda Lake
 d. Tawa Reservoir

List-II
 i. Goa
 ii. Andhra Pradesh
 iii. Madhya Pradesh
 iv. Bihar

Select the correct code:
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Kolleru Lake–Andhra Pradesh, Nagi Bird Sanctuary–Bihar, Nanda Lake–Goa and Tawa Reservoir–Madhya Pradesh. Therefore, the correct code is a-ii, b-iv, c-i, d-iii; the other codes interchange these State associations.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following States/UTs have five Ramsar sites in the state-wise Ramsar-site list?

1. Gujarat
2. Jammu & Kashmir
3. Karnataka
4. Himachal Pradesh
mcqs.explanation: Gujarat and Jammu & Kashmir each have five Ramsar sites, while Karnataka has four and Himachal Pradesh has three. Thus, exactly two of the listed States/UTs have five Ramsar sites.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding Ramsar sites and their States.

List-I
(a) Loktak Lake
(b) Pala Wetland
(c) Rudrasagar Lake
(d) Khecheopalri Wetland

List-II
(i) Sikkim
(ii) Manipur
(iii) Tripura
(iv) Mizoram
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Loktak Lake–Manipur, Pala Wetland–Mizoram, Rudrasagar Lake–Tripura and Khecheopalri Wetland–Sikkim. Therefore, the correct code is a-ii, b-iv, c-iii, d-i.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Uttar Pradesh has 13 Ramsar sites in the listed state-wise count.
Statement B: Rajasthan has 6 Ramsar sites in the listed state-wise count.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is true because Uttar Pradesh has 13 Ramsar sites. Statement B is false: Rajasthan has 5 Ramsar sites, while the count of 6 applies to Odisha and Punjab.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about Ramsar sites in Tamil Nadu:
1. Sakkarakottai Bird Sanctuary was designated a Ramsar site in 2024.
2. Longwood Shola Reserve Forest was designated a Ramsar site in 2024.
3. Therthangal Bird Sanctuary was designated a Ramsar site in 2024.

How many of the above statements are correct?
options: None of the statements is correct
mcqs.explanation: Exactly one statement is correct: Longwood Shola Reserve Forest was designated in 2024. Sakkarakottai Bird Sanctuary and Therthangal Bird Sanctuary were designated in 2025, making the other two statements false.

mcqs.question: Which of the following gives the complete set of roles associated with Jayaprakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary (Surha Tal)?
options: Ecological balance, groundwater recharge, fisheries and local livelihoods
Ecological balance, groundwater recharge and fisheries only
Groundwater recharge, fisheries and local livelihoods only
Ecological balance and local livelihoods only
mcqs.explanation: Surha Tal contributes to ecological balance, groundwater recharge, fisheries and local livelihoods. The most tempting alternative omits local livelihoods, which is also an associated role.

mcqs.question: Which pair constituted India's 97th and 98th Ramsar Sites on World Wetlands Day 2026?
options: Patna Bird Sanctuary and Goga Beel Lake
Chhari-Dhand Wetland and Goga Beel Lake
Patna Bird Sanctuary and Chhari-Dhand Wetland
mcqs.explanation: Patna Bird Sanctuary and Chhari-Dhand Wetland were India's 97th and 98th Ramsar Sites on World Wetlands Day 2026. Goga Beel Lake was added in October 2025, while Siliserh Lake and Kopra Reservoir were added in December 2025.

mcqs.question: After the addition of Jayaprakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary (Surha Tal), what was Uttar Pradesh's position and total number of Ramsar Sites?
options: Second after Tamil Nadu, with 13 sites
Second after Tamil Nadu, with 20 sites
Third after Tamil Nadu, with 13 sites
mcqs.explanation: Uttar Pradesh had 13 Ramsar Sites and stood second after Tamil Nadu, which had 20. The closest trap retains the correct number but incorrectly changes Uttar Pradesh's position to first.

mcqs.question: In which month was Goga Beel Lake added as a Ramsar Site?
mcqs.explanation: Goga Beel Lake was added in October 2025. September 2025 was associated with Gokul Reservoir and Udaipur Jheel, while December 2025 was associated with Siliserh Lake and Kopra Reservoir.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary was added on 22 April 2026, taking India's Ramsar total to 98.
Statement B: Jayaprakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary (Surha Tal) was added in June 2026, taking India's Ramsar total to 99.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are false. Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary took India's total to 99, while Jayaprakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary (Surha Tal) took it to 100.

mcqs.question: Who announced the additions of Patna Bird Sanctuary and Chhari-Dhand Wetland as Ramsar Sites?
mcqs.explanation: Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav announced the additions of Patna Bird Sanctuary and Chhari-Dhand Wetland. The other options are associated with Ramsar Sites rather than the announcing authority.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements regarding Ramsar Site additions in 2025 are correct?

1. Bihar got three sites: Gokul, Udaipur Jheel and Goga Beel.
2. Rajasthan got three sites: Menar, Khichan and Siliserh.
3. Bihar got three sites: Gokul, Udaipur Jheel and Siliserh.
4. Rajasthan got three sites: Menar, Khichan and Goga Beel.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct, so the answer is Only two. Statements 3 and 4 incorrectly interchange Siliserh and Goga Beel between Rajasthan and Bihar.

mcqs.question:
With reference to India’s Ramsar sites as of June 2026, consider the following statements:
1. India has 100 Ramsar sites covering about 14 lakh hectares.
2. India ranks first in Asia and third in the world.
3. The number of sites rose from 26 in 2012 to 98 in January 2026 and 100 in June 2026, with 55 sites added after 2020.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: India had 100 Ramsar sites covering about 14 lakh hectares and ranked first in Asia and third globally. Statement 3 is incorrect because 56, not 55, sites were added after 2020.

mcqs.keyword: Only Ramsar site in Andhra Pradesh
mcqs.question: Which is the only Ramsar site in Andhra Pradesh, designated in 2002?
mcqs.explanation: Kolleru Lake is the only Ramsar site in Andhra Pradesh and was designated in 2002. Chilika Lake is in Odisha, Renuka Wetland is in Himachal Pradesh, and Sundarbans is in West Bengal.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the reported growth in India’s Ramsar sites, consider the following statements:
Statement A: One source gives 26 sites in 2014, with growth of over 276% to 98 sites.
Statement B: The other source gives 26 sites in 2013.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is correct: one source gives 26 sites in 2014 and growth of over 276% to 98 sites. Statement B is incorrect because the other source gives the starting figure as 26 sites in 2012, not 2013.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Tamil Nadu has the highest number of Ramsar sites among Indian States.
Reason (R): Tamil Nadu has 20 Ramsar sites.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the assertion and the reason are true, and the reason explains the assertion: Tamil Nadu holds the record for the most Ramsar sites, with 20. The record is not held by another State in the listed facts.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements regarding India’s Ramsar-site records are correct?
1. Uttar Pradesh ranks second with 13 sites, after the addition of Surha Tal.
2. Kolleru Lake is the only Ramsar site in Andhra Pradesh and was designated in 2002.
3. The older list of 98 sites showed Uttar Pradesh with 11 sites; the number became 13 with Shekha Jheel and Surha Tal.
4. Uttar Pradesh has the highest number of Ramsar sites, with 20 sites.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct. Statement 4 is incorrect because Tamil Nadu, not Uttar Pradesh, has the highest number of sites with 20.

mcqs.question:
Match the following Ramsar sites of Bihar with their years of designation.

List-I
 a. Nakti Bird Sanctuary
 b. Gogul Jalsahay (Gokul Reservoir)
 c. Udaipur Jheel
 d. Gogabil Lake

List-II
 i. 2025
 ii. 2024
 iii. 2020
 iv. 2022
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Nakti Bird Sanctuary–2024, Gogul Jalsahay–2025, Udaipur Jheel–2025 and Gogabil Lake–2025. The tempting alternative changes the years of Nakti Bird Sanctuary, Udaipur Jheel or Gogabil Lake.

mcqs.question: Which Ramsar site was designated in Chhattisgarh in 2025?
mcqs.explanation: Kopra Jalsahay, also called Kopra Reservoir, was designated as a Ramsar site in Chhattisgarh in 2025. Gogul Jalsahay is the similarly named site associated with Bihar.

mcqs.question:
Match the following Ramsar sites of Gujarat with their years of designation.

List-I
 a. Nalsarovar
 b. Wadhvana Wetland
 c. Thol Lake Wildlife Sanctuary
 d. Khijadiya Wildlife Sanctuary

List-II
 i. 2021
 ii. 2012
 iii. 2022
 iv. 2025
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Nalsarovar–2012, Wadhvana Wetland–2021, Thol Lake Wildlife Sanctuary–2021 and Khijadiya Wildlife Sanctuary–2022. The other codes incorrectly assign 2021, 2022 or 2025 to these Gujarat sites.

mcqs.question: Which Ramsar site of Haryana was designated in 2021 and is a wildlife sanctuary?
mcqs.explanation: Bhindawas Wildlife Sanctuary was designated as a Ramsar site in Haryana in 2021. Sultanpur National Park was also designated in Haryana in 2021, but it is not the sanctuary asked for here.

mcqs.keyword: Ramsar designation years in Himachal Pradesh
mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Pong Dam Lake was designated as a Ramsar site in 2006.
Statement B: Chandertal Wetland was designated as a Ramsar site in 2006.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is false because Pong Dam Lake was designated in 2002, whereas Statement B is true because Chandertal Wetland was designated in 2006. The most tempting error is to assign the common year 2006 to both sites.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about Ramsar sites in Jammu and Kashmir:

1. Hokersar Wetland was designated in 2006.
2. Hygam Wetland Conservation Reserve was designated in 2022.
3. Shallbugh Wetland Conservation Reserve was designated in 2024.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: Hokersar Wetland was designated in 2006 and Hygam Wetland Conservation Reserve in 2022. Statement 3 is incorrect because Shallbugh Wetland Conservation Reserve was also designated in 2022, not 2024.

mcqs.question: Which Ramsar site was designated in Jharkhand in 2025?
mcqs.explanation: Udhwa Lake Bird Sanctuary was designated as a Ramsar site in Jharkhand in 2025. Kopra Jalsahay belongs to Chhattisgarh, Gogabil Lake to Bihar and Bhoj Wetlands to Madhya Pradesh.

mcqs.question:
Match the following Ramsar sites of Karnataka with their years of designation.

List-I
 a. Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary
 b. Ankasamudra Bird Conservation Reserve
 c. Aghanashini Estuary
 d. Magadi Kere Conservation Reserve

List-II
 i. 2024
 ii. 2022
 iii. 2023
 iv. 2025
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary–2022, Ankasamudra Bird Conservation Reserve–2023, Aghanashini Estuary–2024 and Magadi Kere Conservation Reserve–2024. The other options interchange the 2022, 2023 and 2024 designations.

mcqs.question:
Match the following Ramsar sites of Kerala with their years of designation.

List-I
 a. Asthamudi Wetland
 b. Sasthamkotta Lake
 c. Vembanad–Kol Wetland
 d. Tso Kar Wetland Complex

List-II
 i. 2020
 ii. 2002
 iii. 2006
 iv. 2022
mcqs.explanation: Asthamudi Wetland, Sasthamkotta Lake and Vembanad–Kol Wetland were all designated in 2002; Tso Kar Wetland Complex was designated in 2020. The distractors incorrectly shift one or more Kerala sites to 2006, 2020 or 2022.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Bhoj Wetlands was designated as a Ramsar site in 2022.
Statement B: Sirpur Wetland was designated as a Ramsar site in 2022.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is false because Bhoj Wetlands was designated in 2002. Statement B is true because Sirpur Wetland was designated in 2022.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Sakhya Sagar was designated as a Ramsar site in 2022.
Reason (R): Yashwant Sagar was designated as a Ramsar site in 2022.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the Assertion and the Reason are true: Sakhya Sagar and Yashwant Sagar were each designated as Ramsar sites in 2022. However, the designation of Yashwant Sagar does not explain the designation of Sakhya Sagar.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about Kabartal Wetland is incorrect?
options: Kabartal Wetland is a Ramsar site in Bihar.
Kabartal Wetland is listed among the Ramsar sites of Bihar.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that Kabartal Wetland was designated in 2021; its correct year of designation is 2020. The other statements correctly identify Kabartal Wetland as a Ramsar site of Bihar and state its designation status.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Sultanpur National Park was designated as a Ramsar site in 2021.
Reason (R): Renuka Wetland was designated as a Ramsar site in 2002.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Assertion A is true because Sultanpur National Park was designated in 2021. Reason R is false because Renuka Wetland was designated in 2006, not 2002; therefore, R cannot explain A.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about Ramsar sites in Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh:
1. Surinsar–Mansar Lakes was designated as a Ramsar site in 2006.
2. Tsomoriri Lake was designated as a Ramsar site in 2002.
3. Surinsar–Mansar Lakes is in Jammu & Kashmir, while Tsomoriri Lake is in Ladakh.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct: Surinsar–Mansar Lakes is a Ramsar site of Jammu & Kashmir designated in 2006, while Tsomoriri Lake is a Ramsar site of Ladakh designated in 2002. The other options omit one of these correct statements.

mcqs.question:
With reference to Maharashtra’s Ramsar sites, consider the following statements:
1. Nandur Madhameshwar was designated in 2020.
2. Lonar Lake was designated in 2022.
3. Thane Creek was designated in 2022.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 3 are correct: Nandur Madhameshwar was designated in 2020 and Thane Creek in 2022. Statement 2 is incorrect because Lonar Lake was designated in 2020, not 2022.

mcqs.question: Chilika Lake, a Ramsar site designated in 1981, is located in which State?
mcqs.explanation: Chilika Lake is the Ramsar site of Odisha designated in 1981. Punjab, Rajasthan and West Bengal are associated with other Ramsar sites in this list.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding Ramsar sites in Odisha.

List-I
(a) Satkosia Gorge
(b) Tampara Lake
(c) Hirakud Reservoir
(d) Ansupa Lake

List-II
(i) 2020
(ii) 2022
(iii) 2002
(iv) 1981
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-ii, c-ii and d-ii: Satkosia Gorge, Tampara Lake, Hirakud Reservoir and Ansupa Lake were all designated in 2022. The other codes assign years not given for these four sites.

mcqs.question: Harike Lake, designated as a Ramsar site in 1990, is located in which State?
mcqs.explanation: Harike Lake is located in Punjab and was designated in 1990. Odisha, Rajasthan and Maharashtra have separate Ramsar-site entries.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding Ramsar sites in Punjab.

List-I
(a) Kanjli Lake
(b) Ropar Lake
(c) Beas Conservation Reserve
(d) Keshopur–Miani Community Reserve

List-II
(i) 1990
(ii) 2002
(iii) 2020
(iv) 2022
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Kanjli Lake-2002, Ropar Lake-2002, Beas Conservation Reserve-2020 and Keshopur–Miani Community Reserve-2020. The other options interchange the designation years.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding Ramsar sites in Rajasthan.

List-I
(a) Keoladeo Ghana National Park
(b) Sambhar Lake
(c) Menar Wetland Complex
(d) Khichan Wetland

List-II
(i) 1981
(ii) 1990
(iii) 2020
(iv) 2025
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Keoladeo Ghana National Park-1981, Sambhar Lake-1990, Menar Wetland Complex-2025 and Khichan Wetland-2025. The tempting alternatives change one or more of these designation years.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Siliserh Lake was designated as a Ramsar site in 2022.
Statement B: Siliserh Lake is a Ramsar site of Rajasthan designated in 2026.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are false. Siliserh Lake is a Ramsar site of Rajasthan designated in 2025, not in 2022 or 2026.

mcqs.keyword: Uttar Pradesh Ramsar sites and years
mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding Ramsar sites in Uttar Pradesh.

List-I
(a) Upper Ganga River
(b) Nawabganj Bird Sanctuary
(c) Parvati Arga Bird Sanctuary
(d) Saman Bird Sanctuary

List-II
(i) 2006
(ii) 2020
(iii) 2021
(iv) 2022
mcqs.explanation: Upper Ganga River was designated in 2006, while Nawabganj Bird Sanctuary, Parvati Arga Bird Sanctuary and Saman Bird Sanctuary were designated in 2020. The other codes assign incorrect years to these sites.

mcqs.keyword: Uttar Pradesh Ramsar sites and years
mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding Ramsar sites in Uttar Pradesh.

List-I
(a) Samaspur Bird Sanctuary
(b) Sandi Bird Sanctuary
(c) Sarsai Nawar Jheel
(d) Sur Sarovar

List-II
(i) 2020
(ii) 2021
(iii) 2022
(iv) 2026
mcqs.explanation: Samaspur Bird Sanctuary, Sandi Bird Sanctuary, Sarsai Nawar Jheel and Sur Sarovar were all designated in 2020. The other options introduce years not applicable to these four sites.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Jayaprakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary / Surha Tal is a Ramsar site in Uttar Pradesh.
Reason (R): It was designated as a Ramsar site in 2026.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the assertion and the reason are true: Jayaprakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary / Surha Tal is in Uttar Pradesh and was designated in 2026. However, the year of designation does not explain the site’s location in Uttar Pradesh.

mcqs.question: Asan Conservation Reserve, designated as a Ramsar site in 2020, is located in which State?
mcqs.explanation: Asan Conservation Reserve is located in Uttarakhand and was designated in 2020. Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and West Bengal have separate Ramsar-site entries.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Ramsar sites in Uttar Pradesh:
1. Haiderpur Wetland was designated in 2021.
2. Bakhira Wildlife Sanctuary was designated in 2020.
3. Patna Bird Sanctuary (Etah) was designated in 2025.
mcqs.explanation: Only statement 1 is correct: Haiderpur Wetland was designated in 2021. Bakhira Wildlife Sanctuary was designated in 2022 and Patna Bird Sanctuary (Etah) in 2026.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: East Calcutta Wetlands was designated as a Ramsar site in 2019.
Statement B: Sundarbans Wetland was designated as a Ramsar site in 2002.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are false. East Calcutta Wetlands was designated in 2002, whereas Sundarbans Wetland was designated in 2019.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following correctly identify a Ramsar site and its inclusion in the 1990 batch?
1. Loktak Lake — 1990
2. Harike Lake — 2002
3. Sambhar Lake — 2025
4. Wular — 2020
mcqs.explanation: Only one entry is correct: Loktak Lake is included in the 1990 batch. Harike Lake, Sambhar Lake and Wular are also in the 1990 batch, so the years shown for them are incorrect.

mcqs.question: Which State has the most Ramsar sites, with 20 sites, according to the given environmental assessment?
mcqs.explanation: Tamil Nadu has the most Ramsar sites, numbering 20. Kerala, Odisha and Gujarat are not identified with this number in the stated fact.

mcqs.question: Which Ramsar site is Tamil Nadu’s oldest?
mcqs.explanation: Point Calimere Wildlife & Bird Sanctuary is Tamil Nadu’s oldest Ramsar site. The other options are later entries in the listed Ramsar-site chronology.

mcqs.question: Koothankulam Bird Sanctuary was designated a Ramsar site in which year?
mcqs.explanation: Koothankulam Bird Sanctuary received Ramsar-site designation in 2022. The other years do not match its listed designation year.

mcqs.question: Pallikaranai Marsh Reserve Forest was designated a Ramsar site in which year?
mcqs.explanation: Pallikaranai Marsh Reserve Forest was designated a Ramsar site in 2022. The other three years are not its listed designation year.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Gulf of Mannar Marine Biosphere Reserve was designated a Ramsar site in 2024.
Statement B: Vembannur Wetland Complex was designated a Ramsar site in 2024.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are false. Gulf of Mannar Marine Biosphere Reserve and Vembannur Wetland Complex were each designated Ramsar sites in 2022, not 2024.

mcqs.question:
Match the following Ramsar sites with their years of designation:

List-I
(a) Vellode Bird Sanctuary
(b) Udhayamarthandapuram Bird Sanctuary
(c) Vedanthangal Bird Sanctuary
(d) Suchindram Theroor Wetland Complex

List-II
(i) 2002
(ii) 2022
(iii) 2024
(iv) 2025
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-ii, c-ii and d-ii: all four sites were designated Ramsar sites in 2022. The other codes assign different years to one or more of these sites.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Vaduvur Bird Sanctuary was designated a Ramsar site in 2024.
Statement B: Kanjirankulam Bird Sanctuary was designated a Ramsar site in 2024.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are false. Vaduvur Bird Sanctuary and Kanjirankulam Bird Sanctuary were each designated Ramsar sites in 2022.

mcqs.question: Which option correctly states the Ramsar designation years of Kazhuveli Bird Sanctuary and Nanjarayan Bird Sanctuary?
mcqs.explanation: Kazhuveli Bird Sanctuary and Nanjarayan Bird Sanctuary were both designated Ramsar sites in 2024. The other options alter the designation year of one or both sanctuaries.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about Tamil Nadu Ramsar sites:
1. Chitrangudi Bird Sanctuary was designated as a Ramsar site in 2022.
2. Karikili Bird Sanctuary was designated as a Ramsar site in 2022.
3. Chitrangudi Bird Sanctuary was designated as a Ramsar site in 2024.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: both Chitrangudi Bird Sanctuary and Karikili Bird Sanctuary were designated in 2022. Statement 3 is incorrect because Chitrangudi Bird Sanctuary was designated in 2022, not 2024.

mcqs.question: Pichavaram Mangroves was designated as a Ramsar site in which year?
mcqs.explanation: Pichavaram Mangroves was designated as a Ramsar site in 2022. The other years listed correspond to different Ramsar-site entries, not Pichavaram Mangroves.
